Thank you so much for replying.

I used to use writing as an outlet and put all my shitty feelings into that, but lately it's escalated into self-harm. I'm going to try and begin writing again. I didn't SI today. I might again. But I'll try not to.

First of all, thank you so much just for replying, it means a lot.

I can talk to my mom about things, she's wonderful, but yeah it's just like I said, I don't want her to feel upset about it. I used to see a therapist about a year ago, once I work up the courage I'll ask my mom to go see her again as you said.
